Overview

Baltimore is a city in MD with a population of 569,931. Charm City with crab cakes, Inner Harbor, and surprisingly affordable row houses. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
